relationships.subject: CB1R

key_findings: Peripherally restricted cannabinoid PrNMI pretreatment prevented GTN- and sumatriptan-induced allodynia and latent sensitization in mouse migraine models, via CB1R and CB2R.
PrNMI suppressed ASIC and TRPA1 currents in trigeminal neurons through CB1R, and prevented GTN-induced increases in nNOS, p-PKA and TRPA1.
